cases.name: samples
cases.pins: the five kill fixtures, transitive A->B, SCC (pure, mutating, unknown), receiver, local alias, reassigned parameter, return alias, static initialization, lambda, virtual

cases.name: missing_callee
cases.pins: a direct call with no record is Unknown, logged '(no summary)'

cases.name: constructor_result
cases.pins: a returned receiver with no receiver at the call (a constructor) is heap; a kept constructor argument escapes

cases.name: unknown_root_write
cases.pins: a write through a value an unknown call returned is an unknown write

cases.name: local_cycle
cases.pins: local sources resolve through cycles; an indirect write through a local is the parameter's borrow_mut

cases.name: unknown_keeps_inert_plain
cases.pins: an unmodelled construct is Unknown everywhere except inert by-value parameters

cases.name: scc_return_alias
cases.pins: return aliases converge around a three-method cycle; a write through the result maps back to the argument

cases.name: heap_through_callee
cases.pins: a callee's borrow_mut / may_escape on a heap argument is an instance write of the caller

cases.name: dispatch_kinds
cases.pins: virtual, delegate and extern dispatch are Unknown on the receiver and every argument

cases.name: receiver_mapping
cases.pins: a callee's receiver effect lands on the caller's receiver argument
